subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should CodexBar collect detailed Cursor dashboard usage-event history under the existing cost-summary consent, require a separate Cursor-specific opt-in, or keep Cursor limited to summary status data?
rationale: Tests cannot determine whether detailed authenticated history collection and billing-like estimates fit the intended privacy and product boundary; the repository owner has explicitly reserved this decision.

options.title: Require Cursor-specific opt-in
options.body: Add an explicit disclosure and disabled-by-default Cursor history control before enabling the detailed dashboard fetch.

options.title: Use existing cost consent
options.body: Treat enabling the global cost summary as sufficient consent, while still fixing selected-account routing and documentation.

options.title: Keep summary-only Cursor
options.body: Do not collect detailed event history and leave Cursor limited to its existing status and quota information.

recommendation.title: Require Cursor-specific opt-in
recommendation.body: Add an explicit disclosure and disabled-by-default Cursor history control before enabling the detailed dashboard fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the repository owner and has already defined and held this exact product/privacy decision.
